explicit_strategy_reopening.trigger: auto-trigger architect if 3 consecutive iterations are within 1% or score dropped
explicit_strategy_reopening.architect_role: classify topology and recommend one-iteration migration steps such as single-call->RAG/tools, chain->parallel, ReAct->better stopping/hierarchical routing, hierarchical->router changes, accuracy ceiling->ensemble/verification

rules: 3 scores within 2% => consider architect or stop
plateau_stop_competes_with_reopen.interpretation: strategy reopening is implemented as a heuristic branch, not as a mandatory evidence-triggered control transition

selection_surface.dataset_split: single random 70% train / 30% held_out assignment at setup
selection_surface.winner_selection: each iteration compares candidates on held_out and chooses the highest held_out score; pairwise comparison also honors held_out
selection_surface.outer_test: no distinct third untouched split is created by setup.py
selection_surface.interpretation: the score trajectory used to detect plateau/regression is adaptively reused selection feedback, not untouched generalization evidence

regression_boundary.held_out_guard_contamination_fix: changelog v5.1.2 states held_out failures no longer contaminate train
regression_boundary.remaining_issue: keeping held_out out of regression guards does not prevent repeated adaptive use of held_out for candidate selection and strategy-control triggers

causal_evidence.note: the repository documents real evolution runs and score improvements, but this audit found no matched experiment isolating the architect/reopening trigger from ordinary proposer search, extra compute, or repeated held_out adaptation

arms: heuristic architect reopening on reused selection score
scheduled architect reopening at matched compute
evidence-triggered reopening using a separately budgeted diagnostic stream while preserving the same promotion rule
measure: reopening false-positive rate: strategy changes followed by no outer improvement

scope: This is an implementation audit of the cited public revision, not a causal validation of strategy reopening.
Do not treat the repository's held_out split as a final lockbox because it is queried every evolution iteration.
Do not infer that stopping on plateau is inferior to reopening; the matched intervention remains untested.
